Package yams.telemetry

Class SwerveModuleTelemetryConfig

java.lang.Object
yams.telemetry.SwerveModuleTelemetryConfig
public class SwerveModuleTelemetryConfig extends Object
Swerve module telemetry configuration.

Use this builder to select exactly which fields are published to NetworkTables and/or DataLog. Every field is disabled by default; call the individual with*() methods to opt in, or use withTelemetryVerbosity(yams.motorcontrollers.SmartMotorControllerConfig.TelemetryVerbosity) to enable a predefined set.

Example


 SwerveModuleTelemetryConfig telemetryCfg =
     new SwerveModuleTelemetryConfig()
         // choose a verbosity preset (LOW / MID / HIGH), or enable fields individually below
         .withTelemetryVerbosity(TelemetryVerbosity.HIGH)
         .withAbsoluteEncoder()
         .withState()
         // disable NT4 output (e.g. during competition) and log to DataLog instead
         .withoutNetworkTables()
         .withDataLogName("swerve/modules/frontleft");
